items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Backs $270 Million Stablecoin Push With Project Faro
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS), Citigroup, and several large banks are committing $270m to launch a new stablecoin project called Project Faro. Project Faro is designed as a U.S. dollar pegged stablecoin targeting both institutional clients and retail users across global markets. The consortium aims to compete directly with established crypto native stablecoins within a digital asset sector estimated at about $290b. items.title: Goldman Sachs Names Top Picks in Business & Information Services Sector
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs has identified five leading stocks in the Americas business and information services sector, highlighting companies with strong growth momentum and expanding profit margins. The selections span uniform services, data storage, credit ratings, and professional information providers, with analysts pointing to artificial intelligence adoption and infrastructure buildout as key growth drivers across multiple names.
